C0458.title: China's First Case Against a Telecom Operator for Upstream Telecom Fraud: Yuante Company Provided "Black SIM Cards"
keywords: refusing to fulfill information network security management obligations
C0458.summary: In 2019, Yunnan police investigated a telecom fraud case and found that the criminal group used "black SIM cards" supplied through the virtual network operator Yuante (Beijing) Communication Technology Co., Ltd. The company knew its agent Yafeida was illegally selling large quantities of phone cards for criminal activity but failed to intervene and continued supplying cards. In April 2021, Yuante's chairman and executives were convicted of refusing to fulfill information-network security management obligations.

references.title: National First Ruling: Cutting Off the Back-End Enablers of Telecom Fraud
China's first telecom operator case for refusing to fulfill information-network security management obligations was adjudicated in Yunnan
